predictions.selection_reason: reads cookies from document.cookie -> used for authentication and configuration -> direct consumption of stored sensitive data
predictions.source_summary: Reads values from document.cookie (client-side storage controlled by browser/user)
predictions.sink_summary: Used to initialize settings including 'password', 'host', 'port' which are then passed to RFB connection functions
predictions.guard_summary: No validation or sanitization of cookie values before use; values are read directly and passed to sensitive operations
predictions.risk_pattern: Untrusted cookie values (potentially attacker-controlled via XSS) are read and used directly for authentication and connection parameters without validation
predictions.context_summary: Function reads cookies used for VNC client configuration including sensitive authentication data
unresolved_facts: Whether cookie values are properly sanitized before being set
Whether there are XSS vulnerabilities that could allow cookie manipulation
Whether RFB library properly validates the password parameter

top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive cookies set by a server can be read by the client if the `httpOnly` flag is not set.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Set HttpOnly flag on session cookies to prevent JavaScript access. Also use Secure and SameSite attributes.

top_sast_rules.description: DOM functions that act like 'eval' and execute strings as code are dangerous and impede program analysis and understanding. Consequently, they should not be used.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-93 crlf-injection carriage-return line-feed newline header response-splitting http-header redirect cookie
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject CR/LF in protocol metadata and use validating framework APIs.

top_sast_rules.description: If two functions with the same name are declared in the same scope, one of the declarations overrides the other without warning. This makes the code hard to read and maintain, and may even lead to platform-dependent behavior.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Remove unused variables that may contain sensitive data. Use static analysis tools to identify unused code. Review code for potential logic errors.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information in a Cookie
top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive information stored without encryption or hashing can expose it to an attacker.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-315. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-471 assumed-immutable immutable-data hidden-field cookie reverse-dns attacker-modified trusted-value mutable security-decision
top_sast_rules.remediation: Do not trust client-modifiable values as immutable security state.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Client-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against allowlists. Use relative URLs where possible and avoid user-controlled redirects.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive information is written to debug or diagnostic log files.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-534 debug-log diagnostic-log verbose-log sensitive-log password token credential secret exception stacktrace logging
top_sast_rules.remediation: Redact secrets and disable sensitive diagnostic logging.
